idea-plugin.name: AI Playground
idea-plugin.description:
AI Playground is a built-in tool for PyCharm that lets you experiment with AI models right inside your IDE. It’s designed to make prompt testing and model comparison fast, simple, and seamless - no complex setup or context switching required.

What you can do with AI Playground:
  • Send Prompts Directly from Code:
    • In AI projects, the Playground will automatically detect prompt-like code and display a gutter notification, letting you send it to the AI Playground with one click.
  • Use your own models
    • Bring your own API tokens (OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral) or access models from the JetBrains AI subscription.
  • Run local models with Ollama
    • Work offline using local LLMs - ideal for private or local workflows.
  • Compare multiple models
    • Send the same prompt to up to five models at once and easily compare model responses.
  • Tune your prompts
    • Adjust settings like temperature, max tokens, and top-p. Add system prompts or use variables to experiment with different inputs.

AI Playground helps you test, iterate, and fine-tune AI interactions - without ever leaving PyCharm.

We value your feedback

You can upvote existing issues in our YouTrack or log in and create a new one.
